turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I've just been trying to get through my daily routine, you know? Got a lot on my plate with work and stuff at home. (pauses) I'm not really sure what else to say.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: That's okay. It's natural to be feeling overwhelmed. Is there anything else you'd like to talk about? Maybe something you've been holding back on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (slightly defensive) I don't know... I'm just trying to get through the day, really. I don't want to talk about anything else. What's this about, anyway?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I'm just here to help you process whatever is on your mind. We can talk about anything you'd like to discuss. Is there anything else you'd like to talk about?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) I don't know... I've been reading a lot about... (pauses, then suddenly becomes more animated) Oh, I just finished that new book on astronomy! Have you read it? The way they describe the Higgs boson particle is fascinating... (trails off)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: That sounds interesting. Is there anything else you'd like to talk about? Maybe something related to that book?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (gets slightly off-track) Yeah, I've been thinking about the implications of dark matter on galaxy formation... (pauses, then seems to realize they're not directly answering the question) Wait, what were you asking again?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I was asking if there was anything else you'd like to talk about.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) No, I think that's it for now. I've just got a lot on my mind and I'm trying to get some things sorted out. (pauses) Can we just wrap this up?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Of course. Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (slightly annoyed) No, I think we're done here. Thank you, I guess.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (frustrated) No, really, I've said everything I need to say. Can we just end the session now?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Sure, I can end the session now. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss before we finish?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (exasperated) No, there's nothing else to discuss. Just end it.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Okay, I will. Is there anything else you need before we finish?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (firmly) No, I'm good. Just let me leave.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Alright, I'll let you leave. Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (still firm, but slightly irritated) No. Nothing else. I'm out of here.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Okay, I'll let you leave. Have a good day.
